selection_basis: The 2024 SAFE is the latest full assessment located for the current Gulf of Alaska unit; author-recommended model m22.5a underpins 2025 advice. The report provides catch, VAST survey biomass and uncertainty, fishery and survey age compositions, biological assumptions, and comparable annual population outputs. The 2026 document is a harvest projection without refitting. Select for source curation while explicitly resolving the fishery-age year discrepancy and preserving the missing maturity observations and survey timing as gaps.
